description_en: Creates a remediation setting for a rule in a specified account group
description_zh: 为指定账号组规则创建修正
kebab_example: aliyun config create-aggregate-remediation --config-rule-id cr-6b7c626622af00b40000 --remediation-type OOS --remediation-template-id ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl --invoke-type MANUAL_EXECUTION --params bucketName_:_resourceId_,_regionId_:_regionId_,_permissionName_:_private --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAggregateRemediation

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain the rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The remediation type. Valid values:

OOS: CloudOps Orchestration Service (template remediation).
FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
parameters.help_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（模板修正）。
FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The remediation template ID.

If RemediationType is set to `OOS`, this parameter is set to `ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`. For information about how to obtain the remediation template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html.

If RemediationType is set to `FC`, this parameter is set to the Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the function, such as `acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`
parameters.help_zh:
修正模板ID。

当`RemediationType`为`OOS`时，该参数为`ACS-OSS-PutBucketAcl`。关于如何获取修正模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html。

当`RemediationType`为`FC`时，该参数为函数计算的ARN，例如：`acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:100931896542****:services/ConfigService.LATEST/functions/test-php`
parameters.name: remediation_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:
NON_EXECUTION: not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: not configured
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置
parameters.name: invoke_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the remediation template. Valid values:
ALIYUN (default): Chinese site template.
CUSTOM: custom template. (Set this value for custom FC remediation.)
NONE: none
parameters.help_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：
ALIYUN（默认值）：官网模板。
CUSTOM：自定义模板。（自定义FC修正时需要填写此值）
NONE：无
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The parameters of the remediation setting.

For information about how to obtain the parameters of the remediation setting, see the TemplateDefinition parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正设置的参数。

关于如何获取修正设置的参数，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/416781.html中的参数0
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
